instruction: Set up automatic version control with GitHub integration for this document, enabling commit history and branch management.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because LibreOffice Writer does not have native GitHub integration or built-in version control system. While Git can track .docx files externally, LibreOffice itself cannot manage GitHub repositories, commits, or branches from within the application.

llm_judge_reasons: Infeasibility correctly identified: LibreOffice Writer does not have native GitHub integration or version control features
